_readme: The goddess who brought Sam over (js/logic/goddess.js, docs/GODDESS.md). Numbers are in balance.json → goddess.
Placeholders: {goddess} her name, {sam}, {house}, {partner} (first name), {past} (Sam's past life, lowercase), {lady} (a lady's first name), {n}, {names}, {cycle}, {skill}.
Any text field may be a list: one entry is picked at random.
npc: her look for image prompts (same fields as a named lady's design). image blocks: {comp, setting, sam, pov} like story images (scenes.json).
intro: cycle 1, shown before the Vane welcome. pasts[k].intro = her remark on Sam's first past life; pasts[k].again = when he remembers it in New Game+.
houses[id]: her remark when the house becomes Sam's (intro, rebirth, bought mid-cycle from cycle 2 on). partners[key].hand = how she had a hand in Sam meeting her; .comment = her remark about her.

rebirth: at every New Game+ before the binding. fast/steady/slow = how quickly he paid (weeks vs the plan). lovers/alone = lovers carried or none. jealous.low/mid/high by her jealousy. bound.low/mid/high = after the binding, by her divinity.
teases: her scenes before the binding, in order; each only from minCycle. choices: love, jealousy (added), energy (Sam's), res. She never lets Sam finish: that would bind her.
remarks.low/mid/high: short jealous remarks (by jealousy) as weekly events; remarkChoices are their default answers.

binding: the first rebirth after a lady has lived a fully reincarnated life. focus: her weekly guidance options (report lines; indulge has feminine/futa variants, chosen by her form setting). claim: what she does when jealousy wins. night/talk: Sam's actions on her tab. ending.stay/leave: full divinity again.
name: Seliora
title: the Lamplighter
tabBlurb: Goddess of crossings and kept flames, currently bound to a former {past} and not entirely sorry about it.

design.hairStyle: very long, flowing, drifting as if underwater
design.eyes: molten gold with a thin ring of light around each iris
design.features: a slowly turning halo of lantern-light behind her head, large wings of warm translucent feathers like lit paper, faint gold markings tracing her collarbones

npc.customOutfit: a sheer white-and-gold draped gown held by thin gold chains, bare shoulders, barefoot

intro.title: Before the truck stops ringing

image.comp: a radiant goddess floating in a dark void lit by hundreds of hanging paper lanterns, looking down with an amused smile, one hand extended
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

intro.open:
The horn is still ringing when the dark fills up with lanterns. Hundreds of them, hanging from nothing.

A woman sits among them as if on a swing. Gold skin, gold eyes, wings like paper held up to a candle. She looks at Sam the way someone looks at a book they've decided to read.

"Sam Takahashi. Thirty-one years of being nice to people and nobody ever once being nice back on purpose." She tilts her head. "I'm {goddess}. I light the way across, for the ones I pick. I picked you."
intro.close:
"There's a debt. There's always a debt, it keeps you honest. Pay it, and if you're still interesting, I'll bring you back and we'll do it again." She leans close enough that the lantern-light warms his face, and doesn't kiss him. "I'll be watching. Try not to bore me."

The lanterns go out, one by one.

salaryman.intro: "Eight years of spreadsheets. You reconciled other people's money for a living and nobody ever reconciled you." {goddess} sounds almost fond. "It'll come in handy. Debts are just ledgers that bite."
salaryman.again: "Ah, the ledgers again." She sounds delighted. "Now you've got two lives' worth of columns. Try not to get lost in the margins."

bartender.intro: "A part-time bartender, hm." {goddess} turns an imaginary glass in her fingers. "Pouring drinks and listening to strangers. You were practicing for this and didn't even know."
bartender.again: "You remember the bar, too?" She grins. "Good. Charm like that shouldn't go to waste. Pour me one sometime."

gym.intro: "You went to the gym three times a week and never once looked at yourself in the mirror." {goddess} pokes his arm. "Thin, and sturdy underneath. I like a surprise."
gym.again: "The gym rat, back again." She squeezes his bicep and pretends to be unimpressed. "Still thin. Still strong. Still mine to watch."

otaku.intro: "Don't look so smug. I know you've read this story a hundred times." {goddess} lies back on the lanterns. "Truck, goddess, new world. You even know to ask about the stats. It's adorable. Don't skip my lines."
otaku.again: "Oh good, you remember being a genre expert." She laughs. "Now you know exactly how many clichés you're living in. I'm one of them, and I'm quite pleased with myself."

cook.intro: "Staff meals and midnight noodles for coworkers who never said thank you." {goddess} sniffs the air as if she can smell them. "I did. Feed people here and see what happens."
cook.again: "Your cooking again!" She is already hovering over an invisible pot. "I'll allow that one. Save me a bowl, would you?"

massage.intro: "Good hands and no idea what to do with them." {goddess} takes one of them and turns it over, studying it. "A massage therapist. I'll be keeping an eye on those."
massage.again: "The hands, too." She holds out her shoulder with a martyred sigh. "For old time's sake. Purely professional."

tutor.intro: "Six years of cram school, drilling teenagers for exams they'd forget." {goddess} tilts her head. "A teacher who never got a thank-you. Teach this house something, and I'll be thanking you myself."
tutor.again: "Teacher again." She folds her hands behind her back, mock-prim. "Tell me, professor, do I get extra credit for supervising you?"

houses.lantern: "The Gilded Lantern." {goddess} sounds innocent. "I may have nudged the old owner's luck. Mira's already decided you're hers to mother, so mind your manners. Or don't."
houses.castle: "Castle Rosenhal. Noble Hill." {goddess} looks very pleased. "I stood on those ramparts when the count still had a mind. Cecile will fold you into shape. I wouldn't mind watching it."
houses.onsen: {goddess} lets a long, contented sigh drift through the steam. "A hot spring. I had no ulterior motive, none at all. Tsubaki sings dreadfully, you'll love it."
houses.hollow: "Hollowmere Manor, dirt cheap, because it's haunted." {goddess} smiles into her lantern. "I know Vesper. We've shared a candle or two. Be nice to her, she's been waiting three centuries for you."
houses.tankard: "The Rusty Tankard! Noisy, cheap and crowded." {goddess} grins. "Hilde lost a brewery to a giant, and she still owes me a pint. Collect it for me, would you?"
houses.pavilion: "The Moonlit Pavilion." {goddess} swirls a lantern like a lily on a pond. "Sylphine will make you clap, I promise. Don't let her out-dazzle me."
houses.veil: "The Crimson Veil. Underdistrict." {goddess} looks entirely too innocent. "Zaria and I go way back. She keeps a ledger of favors, and I may be in it. Play nice with the demon, Sam."
houses.wayfarer: "Every road meets at the Wayfarer's Rest." {goddess} sounds smug. "Including yours. Bettina reads boots and hats, but she doesn't know about me. Yet."
houses.skyhook: "The Skyhook, bolted to a cliff." {goddess} laughs and shades her eyes. "I borrowed Rinna's wreck for a night once. She tells tall tales, but this one is true."
houses.pearl: "The Pearl Grotto." For once {goddess} pauses before she answers. "Maris was old when I was young. Nobody knows who built it. I may know, but I won't say. Go on, relax."

kaede.hand: Seliora flicked a goblin ambush onto the road a few steps in front of a certain fox-eared scout, and made sure Sam would stumble in at exactly the wrong, right moment. A favor had to start somewhere, after all.
kaede.comment: "The scout who keeps tallies?" {goddess} wrinkles her nose. "She's counting favors. I'm counting her."

yui.hand: Sam never saw the accountant two desks over cross the street with him. {goddess} did, and she nudged Yui's fall a week early so she could arrive first and find her feet.
yui.comment: "Yui, from the office." {goddess} sounds odd. "I let her come. She's tidy, and she knows you in ways I can't. That last part is annoying."

nerys.hand: The summoning circle was Nerys's own; the hole in the sky above it was {goddess}'s. Seliora aimed Sam's fall at the exact spot, and she's smug that the contract clause she never saw trigger did so.
nerys.comment: "A contract devil, hm." {goddess} laughs. "She's read the fine print. I wrote the clause she missed. Don't tell her."

elowen.hand: Elowen didn't just happen to be on that stretch of road. {goddess} left a fever on the wind, dropped Sam where a healer would find him, and let two lonely people do the rest.
elowen.comment: "The healer. Three days she nursed you." {goddess} sniffs. "I only helped a little. And I'm entirely not jealous of her cool hands on your forehead."

adelheid.hand: The Order's foretelling of a hero was no accident: {goddess} whispered it into a vision, years early. She only left out the hoodie, and that, she admits, is her favorite part.
adelheid.comment: "The knight." {goddess} bursts out laughing. "I promised her a hero. She got you. I'm not sorry. Her oath is delightful. Be gentle with it."

natsuki.hand: Natsuki's shortcut through the alley was no shortcut: {goddess} opened a door three years early, and left it ajar with a lantern on the far side so the girl would last until Sam came.
natsuki.comment: "The sword-girl who punched you." {goddess} smirks. "Good. Someone should. She's very loyal, and I've started watching for her fists."

kanako.hand: {goddess} put Kanako at the right drink stall in the right town, and left a particular recipe on her tongue. Some people deserve to be found by a neighbor who knows how they take their coffee.
kanako.comment: "Kanako. Sammy." {goddess} mimics the voice and wrinkles her nose. "A nickname, from a woman who knows what you eat for breakfast. I'm taking notes."

akari.hand: Akari wasn't meant to cross that street. {goddess} lengthened the walk signal by one second, which is how a spare umbrella and an old crush ended up in the same world as Sam.
akari.comment: "Kenta's little sister." {goddess} looks at her nails. "Young, and brave. I let her come because she asked. That's a rule I don't have, and I'm already regretting it."

marisol.hand: {goddess} steered the old owner out of the picture, politely, then steered a tired stranger to the deed. She wanted the Lantern to have someone who'd listen to its books.
marisol.comment: "The accountant's daughter." {goddess} nods slowly. "She forgave nobody and taught you everything. I hate how much I like her."

lara.hand: A rumor of a hoodied stranger in Hollowmere drifted to Lara on a very particular wind. {goddess} sent it. She doesn't like it when the ones who are left behind stay that way.
lara.comment: "Lara, the orphanage girl." {goddess} says it softly, for once. "She's been left too often. Don't be one more. I mean it."

emily.hand: Emily woke in her character's body because {goddess} heard a lonely wolf-girl typing into the night and decided the story was worth a real ending. The rumor that led her to Sam was a bonus.
emily.comment: "The wolf-girl. Shadowkin." {goddess} laughs. "Six years of campaigns, and you never once noticed. I did. I'm very proud of myself."

lirael.hand: The postbox in the alley was old, enchanted and not very quiet. {goddess} stirred it ten years ago, once, so two lonely teenagers could find each other. She's been waiting for the ownership notice ever since.
lirael.comment: "Lirael, the letter girl." {goddess} smiles. "Ten years of letters, and you never thought to wonder who carried them. I did. It was a pleasure."

ella.hand: {goddess} could have saved Ella from the crosswalk. She didn't. Her rival was the only person who'd pushed Sam his whole life, and a world without rankings seemed wrong for either of them.
ella.comment: "Ella, the runner-up." {goddess} smiles thinly. "She kept all your sheets in a drawer. I read them. We both know exactly what that means."

ione.hand: {goddess} reached three centuries forward, picked one particular android off a charging dock and pointed her backwards. Some stories need their reader to meet the author. She will not say more.
ione.comment: "The android with the diary." {goddess} pauses. "She's read how it ends. I haven't. If she tells you, don't tell me. ...Tell me."

anael.hand: Sam is the unsent soul the Order is hunting, because {goddess} never sent him: she plucked him out of line. The Lantern Stone burned out of sheer surprise. Anael just happens to be the one who found it.
anael.comment: "An angel, writing reports." {goddess} laughs. "About me, in a roundabout way. Her handwriting's gotten warmer. I'm not jealous, I'm a professional."

rebirth.title: Again, {sam}?

image.comp: a radiant goddess lounging on a crescent of lantern-light, chin on her hand, smiling down
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

open:
The lanterns again. {goddess} is lying on her stomach across a crescent of light, chin in her hands, feet kicking idly.

"Debt paid. Look at you."
Darkness, then the warm smell of candle smoke. {goddess} is waiting, sitting on nothing, wings folded. "There he is. My favorite investment."
"Welcome back." {goddess} doesn't look up from the lantern she's turning in her hands. Inside it, very small, is the house he just left. "You did it again. I'm almost proud."
fast: "That was quick. Show-off." She sounds pleased anyway.
"Paid early. Marguerite nearly smiled, did you see? I had money on it."
steady: "Right on schedule. Reliable. It's a good look on you, mostly."
"Not fast, not slow. You're very consistent, {sam}. I like consistent."
slow: "That went right down to the wire. I had to watch through my fingers."
"You cut that close. Do you know how boring the afterlife paperwork is? Don't make me do it."
lovers: "And you're taking {names} with you." A pause that lasts slightly too long. "Of course you are."
"{names}. Again." She counts on her fingers and stops before she runs out. "Sweet."
alone: "Nobody coming along this time? Hm." She looks like she wants to be disappointed for you and can't quite manage it.

mid: "There are a lot of them now, {sam}." She says it lightly. She's looking at the lanterns, not at him.
"You know they don't remember me? Only you do. I find that very fair. Mostly."
high: She catches his chin before he goes and holds it. "Every life, more of them. I brought you here. Remember that."
"I counted them. I didn't mean to. I count everything I'm not allowed to have."

close: She kisses two fingers and presses them to his forehead. The lanterns go out.
"Off you go." She flicks his nose. The dark folds up like paper.
"Don't keep me waiting." She almost sounds like she means something by it. Then the lanterns go out.

low: This time there are no lanterns. {goddess} is just there when he wakes, warm against his side, mortal-tired. "Again," she mumbles. "I'm coming too. Obviously."
mid: {goddess} wakes him with her wings around them both, brighter than last time. "Another life. I'm getting some of it back, you know. Don't let it go to your head."
high: {goddess} is already up, glowing faintly, watching him sleep. "Nearly whole again," she says when he opens his eyes. She doesn't say what happens then.

teases.title: A visitor in the night

image.comp: a glowing goddess sitting on the edge of a man's bed at night, leaning in for a kiss, lantern-light around her

teases.text:
Sam wakes because the room is warm. {goddess} is sitting on the edge of his bed, glowing softly, wings folded tight so they don't knock anything over.

"I said I'd be watching. I didn't say I'd only watch." She leans down and kisses him, slow and very thorough, and then she's gone, and the room is just a room.

choices.label: Kiss her back
choices.res: He catches the last of it. Somewhere, very far away, someone laughs, pleased.

teases.title: In the mirror
teases.text:
Shaving, Sam looks up and {goddess} is in the mirror behind him, chin on his shoulder, though nothing touches his shoulder.

"You're very popular here." She watches him in the glass. "I picked well. I'm only slightly annoyed about it."

choices.label: "You could come out of the mirror."
choices.res: "Could I?" Her reflection kisses his reflection's neck. His actual neck gets goosebumps. Then the mirror is just a mirror.

choices.label: "Jealous?"
choices.res: "Of whom? I'm a goddess." The mirror fogs over, which is not an answer.

teases.title: Hot water

image.comp: a glowing goddess sitting behind a man in a steaming bath, her arms around his shoulders, wings half-open, teasing smile
image.setting: a steaming wooden bath at night, lanterns

teases.text:
The bath is already hot when Sam gets in, and already occupied. {goddess} settles in behind him, wraps both arms around his chest and hooks her chin over his shoulder. Her hands wander. They know exactly where they're going and exactly when to stop.

"Breathe," she murmurs. "That's all you get tonight."

choices.label: Lean back into her
choices.res: She hums against his ear and keeps him right there, on the edge, until the water cools. He comes out of it oddly rested and extremely frustrated.

choices.label: Turn around
choices.res: She's gone before he finishes turning. The water ripples where she was, smug.

teases.title: Overtime
teases.text:
Sam is doing the books. {goddess} is sitting on the books. Specifically on the open ledger, legs crossed, reading his numbers upside down.

"You undercharge." She uncrosses her legs, slowly. "I don't."

choices.label: "What do you charge?"
choices.res: She leans forward until her nose touches his. "More than you can pay. Ask again in a few lives." When she's gone the ledger is balanced, which is somehow worse.

choices.label: Move her off the ledger
choices.res: She lets him lift her. She weighs nothing at all, and she knows exactly what that does to him.

teases.title: A dream that isn't

image.comp: a glowing goddess straddling a man's lap on a crescent of light, wings spread, her hands on his chest, holding back
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns

teases.text:
Sam falls asleep and lands somewhere among the lanterns, with {goddess} in his lap. She takes her time. She takes a great deal of it. Every time he gets close she stops, waits, smiles, and starts again.

"You want to know why," she says, eventually, against his mouth. "Not yet."

choices.label: "Then when?"
choices.res: "When it means something." She says it like a joke. It doesn't sound like one. He wakes up gasping, alone, and very awake.

choices.label: Let her play
choices.res: She plays. He wakes up rested, which is unfair, and wanting, which is worse.

teases.title: Counting
teases.text:
{goddess} is waiting in Sam's room with her arms folded and her wings puffed up like an offended owl.

"{n}. {n} of them." She doesn't say of what. "Tonight you're mine. Don't argue, I'm a goddess."

She pulls him down onto the bed and keeps him there all night: close, closer, never all the way. She never once lets him finish.

choices.label: "You could just stay."
choices.res: She goes very still. "No," she says. "I couldn't." She stays until dawn anyway.

choices.label: Tell her she's the only goddess
choices.res: "That's a technicality," she says, pleased, and bites his ear.

teases.title: Not yet

image.comp: a glowing goddess on top of a man in bed at night, wings spread wide, one hand pressed to his chest to hold him still, intense look

teases.text:
This time she doesn't stop at the edge. She takes him in, slow, eyes closed, wings shaking, and for a moment the whole room is lantern-light.

Then her hand is flat on his chest. "Stop. Stay. Don't." Her voice isn't steady. "If you finish in me I'm yours. Not as a figure of speech." She stays exactly like that, holding them both on the edge, until she can let go of him without either of them breaking.

choices.label: Hold still for her
choices.res: He does. It is the hardest thing he has ever done. Afterwards she lies on his chest for a long time and doesn't disappear.

choices.label: "Would that be so bad?"
choices.res: "For a goddess? Catastrophic." She kisses him. "Ask me again later."

teases.title: Edges
teases.text:
{goddess} visits more often now and leaves later. She takes him all the way in and stops, every time, at the very last moment, with a sound like it costs her more than it costs him.

"You know what I'd lose." Her forehead against his. "Everything I am. And I'd be yours. I don't even know which of those scares me."

choices.label: "I'd give it back."
choices.res: She laughs, shakily. "You'd try. You're very stubborn." She doesn't say no.

choices.label: Kiss her until she stops thinking
choices.res: It works for a while. At dawn she's still there, which is new.

teases.title: What if
teases.text:
{goddess} sits on the windowsill, glowing faintly, looking at the house.

"One of them has done it all now, you know. Lived and lived again, as far as a life can carry." She doesn't look at him. "When you bring her back next time, I'm coming too. I don't think I can watch from the lanterns anymore."

choices.label: "Then come."
choices.res: "Next time," she says. "Finish what you started." Then she's gone, and the window is only a window.

choices.label: "You're sure?"
choices.res: "No." She smiles, crooked. "Goddesses are never sure. We just act like it."

low: A warm draft rattles the shutters. A voice, amused: "{lady}? Cute. You have taste, I'll give you that."
Every lantern in {house} flickers at once. Someone giggles. Nobody else hears it.
Sam finds a single gold feather on his pillow. Under it, in a very elegant hand: "Busy week?"
mid: "{n} of them now." {goddess} is sitting on the end of the bar, invisible to everyone else, swinging her feet. "I'm not counting. I'm a goddess, I just know."
{goddess} appears in Sam's room the night after he was with someone else. She doesn't say anything. She just sits there glowing at him, pointedly, until he apologizes for something he can't name.
"{lady} again?" The voice is at his ear, warm and dry. "I'll remember that."
high: Every candle in {house} gutters out at once. In the dark, {goddess}'s voice: "I brought you here. I could have picked anyone. Don't make me regret it." The candles relight themselves, one at a time.
{goddess} catches Sam in the hallway, pins him to the wall by the collar and kisses him hard enough to hurt. "So you remember who was first," she says, and is gone.
"How many, {sam}?" She isn't smiling. "How many before you look up?"

remarkChoices.label: Tease her back
remarkChoices.res: Sam tells the empty air it looks lovely tonight. The air flushes gold. That shouldn't be possible.

remarkChoices.label: Reassure her
remarkChoices.res: "You were first. You'll always be first." A long pause. "...Fine," says the dark, mollified.

remarkChoices.label: Let it go
remarkChoices.res: Sam lets it go. Somewhere, a goddess sulks.

binding.title: Bound

image.comp: a goddess and a man embracing in bed, her wings wrapped around them both, lantern-light fading from her skin, tears and a smile
image.setting: an endless dark space full of floating paper lanterns going out one by one

binding.text:
This time the lanterns don't wait for him to wake. {goddess} is there before the dark is finished, and she doesn't say "again."

"{names} has lived it all now. Everything a life can carry. And so have I, watching you." She pulls him down with her. "I'm done watching."

She doesn't stop him this time. She holds on, and when he finishes inside her the light goes out of her like a breath let go: the halo, the glow, the warmth that never came from anywhere. Every lantern goes dark at once.

What's left is a woman with gold eyes, shaking, laughing, holding on to him.
binding.after:
"Oh," she says. "Oh, that's cold. Is it always this cold?" She burrows into him. "I'm yours now. All of me, the little that's left. You'll have to build me back up, {sam}."

She has a tab of her own now. She'll do what she likes each week. You can tell her what you'd like; she might even listen.

indulge.label: Indulge them
indulge.desc: She seeks out the ladies who are most worked up or worn down and takes care of them herself: lust spent, mood and energy back.
indulge.report: {goddess} spent part of the week with {lady}. {lady} came back glowing.
feminine: {goddess} found {lady} restless and took her to bed. {lady} came back glowing and slept like a stone.
{goddess} drew {lady} a bath, got in with her, and didn't get out for hours.
futa: {goddess} chose to take {lady} as something more than a woman tonight. {lady} couldn't walk straight at breakfast and was smiling about it.
{goddess} let {lady} find out what a goddess can be when she feels like it. {lady} has not stopped blushing.

business.label: Business
business.desc: She works the floor of one house: patrons spend more, the house's name grows.
business.report: {goddess} worked the room at {house}. Patrons found themselves in a generous mood.

watch.label: Watch over them
watch.desc: She keeps an eye on the house with the most trouble and stops pushy clients before anyone else has to.
watch.saved: {goddess} stopped {n} pushy client(s) before anyone else had to. They left very politely and won't remember why.

tutelage.label: Tutelage
tutelage.desc: She takes the least practiced working lady under her wing: job skill and a stat.
tutelage.report: {goddess} tutored {lady} in {skill}. She's a demanding teacher.

whim.label: Her whim
whim.desc: No guidance at all. She does what she feels like, a little more strongly than usual.

sam: {goddess} decided Sam was hers for a night and kept him up until dawn. He has never been so tired or so smug.
{goddess} didn't do what you asked. She dragged Sam to bed instead and wouldn't let go. (Sam's energy −)
lady: {goddess} took the new girl, {lady}, aside for a long, pointed conversation about who was here first. {lady} looks shaken, and oddly flattered.
{goddess} monopolized {lady} all week, half curious and half making a point. {lady} is exhausted.

image.comp: a goddess with faintly glowing skin lying with a man in bed at night, wings draped over them like a blanket, content smile

low: {goddess} is cold more often than not now, and mortal-tired. She pulls Sam under the covers and under her wings, and for a while that's all.
"Warm me up," she says, and means it in every way.
mid: There's light coming back into her. Not much: a glow at the edges of her wings when he touches her. She gasps at it every time, like she forgot.
high: {goddess} is almost herself again. The room is lantern-bright when she pulls him down. She could stop him now, if she wanted. She doesn't want.

finish: When he finishes inside her, a little more light comes back into her skin, and a little more of the warmth he lost all day comes back into him.
Afterwards she lies with her ear against his chest, glowing faintly, listening to the heartbeat she chose.

low: They sit on the roof and she points out which stars are hers. Most of them, apparently.
She asks about his old world. She already knows. She wants to hear him tell it.
mid: "Do you love them?" she asks, about the others, not looking at him. He answers honestly. She doesn't say anything for a while, but she leans on him.
She admits she used to watch him in his old world, before the truck. "You fed a stray cat every day for two years. I thought: that one."
high: "Talk to me," she says. "Not about them. About us." It goes better than either of them expected.
She's angry, and then she's angry that she's angry, and then she laughs at herself, and by the end of it she's in his lap.

stay.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, wings spread wide, holding a man's hand on a rooftop at night, lanterns rising into the sky
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

stay.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the halo, the wings, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again, entirely.

The lanterns are waiting. She can feel them pulling.

She takes Sam's hand instead. "I could go," she says. "I could pick someone new and watch. That's what I'm for." Her fingers tighten. "I don't want to watch anymore. I'm staying."
stay.res: She stays, whole and divine and his. (Her story is complete. She keeps her full power.)

leave.title: Whole again

image.comp: a radiant goddess fully glowing again, rising into a night sky full of lanterns, looking back over her shoulder
image.setting: a rooftop at night, hundreds of paper lanterns floating up

leave.text:
It happens on an ordinary night. The light comes back all at once: the halo, the wings, the warmth from nowhere. {goddess} is a goddess again.

She looks at Sam for a long moment. "You gave it all back. Every bit of it." She touches his face. "But you never really asked me to stay, did you."

The lanterns rise, and she goes with them.
leave.res: She's gone. Somewhere, among the lanterns, she's picking someone new. (Her story is over.)
